name: P4 Sport

origin.basis: Italian tire maker; Pirelli says the P ZERO Race range is made at its plant in Italy near its Milan headquarters.

manufacturing.basis: The P4 Sport page does not state where it is made.

positioning: Pirelli's durability-first 26 TPI road clincher for long distances.
pressure_note: Pirelli gives no pressure on the product page; a US retailer lists 87-125 psi for the 28 mm.

availability.note: Found at a US retailer (in-store pickup only on 2026-11-01); European and mainland China sellers were not verified for this line.

price_observations.conditions: Retailer list price on 2026-11-01 for the 28 mm folding tire; in-store pickup only, and the page does not say one tire or a pair.

caveats: A heavy, low-TPI casing chosen for durability rather than speed; no lab test found.
Pirelli does not state tubeless compatibility or a pressure limit; treat it as a tube-type clincher and follow the sidewall.
